title: Permanent and Transient Representations for Continual Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07327v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) agents struggle to adapt to new situations while retaining prior knowledge, leading to a stability-plasticity trade-off. One approach to solving this problem is by using complementary learning systems: one for slow, long-term learning and another for quick, transient adaptation. Anand & Precup (2023) instantiated this idea using permanent and transient value functions, but used the same features in both systems. Intuitively, long-term learning should rely more on parametric representations for broad generalization, while transient learning would be best served by non-parametric representations for situation-specific adaptation. In this paper, we explore this idea both theoretically and empirically. By introducing a novel non-parametric approximation for estimating the transient value function in complex tasks, we demonstrate that our method enables online learning and outperforms competitive basel

translated_title: 持续强化学习中的永久性与瞬态表示
translated_abstract: 持续强化学习（CRL）智能体难以在适应新情况的同时保留先前学到的知识，从而面临稳定性与可塑性之间的权衡。解决这一问题的一种方法是采用互补学习系统：一个用于缓慢的长期学习，另一个用于快速的瞬态适应。Anand & Precup（2023）通过永久价值函数和瞬态价值函数实现了这一思想，但两个系统使用了相同的特征。直观来看，长期学习应更多依赖参数化表示以实现广泛的泛化能力，而瞬态学习则最适合采用非参数化表示以实现针对特定情境的适应。在本文中，我们从理论和实证两方面对这一思想进行了探索。通过引入一种新颖的非参数近似方法来估计复杂任务中的瞬态价值函数，我们证明了我们的方法能够实现在线学习，并且优于竞争性基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出在持续强化学习的互补学习系统中为长期学习采用参数化表示、为瞬态适应采用非参数化表示，并引入一种新颖的非参数近似方法来估计瞬态价值函数，从而实现复杂任务中的在线学习并优于竞争性基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using parametric representations for slow long-term learning and non-parametric representations for transient adaptation in continual reinforcement learning, introducing a novel non-parametric approximation for the transient value function that enables online learning in complex tasks and outperforms competitive baselines.
